description: The record of a feature's memory design: types kept, conversation budget and strategy, long-term store and ranking, isolation, untrusted-write policy, retention and erasure, with forces, alternatives and consequences.
The implementable part of the decision, with numbers a teammate can build and a privacy reviewer can check.
The tokens a call may spend on memory, split between the conversation context and retrieved long-term memories.
The categories of questions users ask (preferences, past events, time-dependent facts). Measure stores per kind, not on one blended score.
Everything a deletion request must reach: memories, summaries, extracted facts, embeddings, caches, and backups by a documented process.
